analysis.investment_thesis: Anand Rathi Wealth is a genuine compounding machine — asset-light wealth management with 47% ROE, 59% ROCE, and near-zero debt growing at 22%+ revenue CAGR over seven years. At 77x trailing P/E and 37.7x book, however, the price already reflects a decade of optimism, leaving little margin of safety for a Munger-style buyer.
key_strengths: Exceptional capital efficiency: ROCE 59%, ROE 47%, with Debt/Equity of just 0.08 — one of the finest capital structures I've seen in Indian financials
Recurring, relationship-driven AUM fee model serving HNI/UHNI clients with high switching costs; Omni platform builds a secondary technology moat with MFD network effects
Consistent free cash flow generation (5/5 years positive OCF), Net Profit CAGR of 31.6% over 7 years, with operating margins holding above 40%
key_risks: Valuation at 77x trailing P/E and 52x forward P/E prices in flawless execution for years; any moderation in India's equity market cycle would contract AUM and compress multiples simultaneously
2026 Other Income surged anomalously to INR 105 Cr (vs INR 1 Cr in 2025), inflating reported net profit of INR 397 Cr — stripping this, core earnings quality is softer than headline numbers suggest
Wealth management faces intensifying competition from banks, large NBFCs, and digital-first platforms; the moat is relationship-based, not structural, and can erode with key personnel attrition
red_flags: INR 105 Cr spike in Other Income in FY2026 requires explanation — one-time gain or accounting reclassification?
OCF/Net Income for FY2026 is approximately 71% (281/397), below the 80% quality threshold, and further distorted by the other-income anomaly
Finance costs have more than doubled in two years (INR 6 Cr in 2024 → INR 16 Cr in 2026), a small but accelerating trend to monitor
analysis.detailed_analysis:
Anand Rathi Wealth is the kind of business Munger admires in principle — asset-light, trust-dependent, recurring revenue, and deeply embedded in a long-duration Indian wealth-creation story. With ROIC well above 35% and a virtually debt-free balance sheet, this is a genuine compounder. The Omni platform for MFDs adds a scalable distribution layer that competitors cannot replicate quickly. Revenue has grown from INR 280 Cr (2019) to INR 1,149 Cr (2026) — a clean, organic expansion.

The problem, as always, is price. At 77x earnings and 37x book, the market has already capitalized every future year of perfection. The mysterious INR 105 Cr Other Income in FY2026 is the kind of accounting quirk that demands scrutiny before paying such a premium. I would want this business at 40-45x earnings, not 77x. Watch it, admire it, but discipline yourself — wonderful businesses at absurd prices are not wonderful investments.
